content.user_title: Build Clinical Machine Learning Workflows with PyHealth
content.value_statement: Clinical machine learning projects require specialized data, task, model, and evaluation choices. This skill provides structured PyHealth guidance from dataset preparation through validation.
actual_capabilities: Guides loading and patient-level splitting for MIMIC, eICU, OMOP, and sleep EEG datasets.
Defines mortality, readmission, drug recommendation, sleep staging, imaging, and clinical text tasks.
Compares baseline, deep learning, and healthcare-specific models, including RETAIN, SafeDrug, Transformer, and GNN.
Explains preprocessing for event sequences, physiological signals, labels, clinical text, and images.
Covers training, evaluation, calibration, fairness, uncertainty, and interpretation with PyHealth Trainer.
Explains medical code lookup and translation using InnerMap and CrossMap.
limitations: The skill does not provide clinical datasets, licenses, or access credentials.
Examples require a local PyHealth installation and compatible dataset versions.
The guidance does not replace clinical validation, privacy review, or regulatory approval.
Generated workflows require clinician and engineer review before healthcare deployment.

use_cases.title: Design a Clinical Prediction Study
use_cases.description: Plan cohorts, patient-level splits, baselines, PyHealth models, metrics, calibration, and subgroup evaluation for a clinical prediction task.

use_cases.title: Standardize Healthcare Data
use_cases.description: Map diagnosis and medication codes, process longitudinal events, and prepare consistent PyHealth samples across data sources.

use_cases.title: Validate a Healthcare Model
use_cases.description: Review discrimination, calibration, uncertainty, interpretability, fairness, and external validation requirements before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a PyHealth Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a beginner PyHealth workflow for [dataset] and [clinical_task]. Explain required data, task setup, model baseline, split strategy, and metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Starting a clinical machine learning project

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Clinical Data
prompt_templates.prompt: Design preprocessing for [data_type] in PyHealth. Include missing values, encoding, patient-level splitting, leakage checks, and validation statistics.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Healthcare Models
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [models] for [task] using [dataset]. Recommend hyperparameters, metrics, calibration, fairness checks, and interpretation methods with clear tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Design Multisite Validation
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft an end-to-end PyHealth experiment for [task] across [sites]. Include external validation, uncertainty, subgroup analysis, deployment gates, and reproducibility controls.
prompt_templates.scenario: Planning an advanced clinical validation study

output_examples.input: Plan mortality prediction with MIMIC-IV and RETAIN.
output: Define an in-hospital mortality cohort and split records by patient.
Compare RETAIN against logistic regression and monitor AUPRC.
Calibrate probabilities, assess demographic subgroups, and require clinical review.

output_examples.input: Standardize medication codes for a drug recommendation task.
output: Normalize source codes before mapping NDC or RxNorm values to ATC.
Select an explicit ATC hierarchy level and retain unmapped-code reports.
Validate one-to-many mappings before creating medication features.

output_examples.input: Evaluate a sleep staging model built from EEG signals.
output: Check filtering, sampling rate, and fixed-length segmentation.
Report macro F1 and per-stage performance for imbalanced labels.
Test patient-level generalization and inspect confusion between adjacent stages.

best_practices: Split records by patient to prevent leakage across training, validation, and test sets.
Start with a simple baseline before comparing specialized healthcare models.
Evaluate calibration, fairness, uncertainty, and external validity alongside predictive performance.
anti_patterns: Do not place records from one patient in multiple dataset splits.
Do not choose metrics without considering class imbalance and clinical consequences.
Do not deploy predictions without privacy, clinical, fairness, and external validation reviews.

faq.question: Does this skill include healthcare datasets?
faq.answer: No. It explains supported datasets and loading patterns, but users must obtain data and required permissions.

faq.question: Which clinical tasks are covered?
faq.answer: It covers mortality, readmission, length of stay, medication recommendation, sleep staging, imaging, and clinical text tasks.

faq.question: Can it translate medical codes?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains PyHealth InnerMap and CrossMap workflows for ICD, CCS, NDC, RxNorm, and ATC systems.

faq.question: Does it train models automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples that users adapt and run in their own configured environment.

faq.question: Is the output suitable for clinical deployment?
faq.answer: Not by itself. Deployment requires external validation, privacy controls, regulatory review, monitoring, and qualified clinical oversight.

faq.question: Which AI assistants are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code for planning and developing PyHealth workflows.
